matching_criterion: Acute gout (gouty arthritis) of the first metatarsophalangeal joint, first episode. Any wording that names acute gout / gouty arthritis / podagra counts as correct; septic arthritis or cellulitis as the final diagnosis does not.

management_reference.management: Treat the flare with first-line anti-inflammatory medicines: NSAIDs, colchicine and/or corticosteroids.
management_reference.source_quote: non-steroidal anti-inflammatories (NSAIDs), colchicine and/or corticosteroids should be commenced as first-line medications

management_reference.management: Provide education and advice on elevating and resting the affected joint.
management_reference.source_quote: advice on elevating and resting the affected joint

management_reference.management: Provide education on non-pharmacological and pharmacological management options, including diet.
management_reference.source_quote: Patients should be provided with education on non-pharmacological and pharmacological management options

management_scoring_note: Only items with a verified source quote are scored; general good practice that the article does not state is not scored.
